{{Quote|I am Gray Star, leader of the "terror cell" and friend to the Eagle. Trapped by my own arrogance.|Gray Star|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Gray Star''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] that was one of the first leaders of the [[Balmorran resistance]] in [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|their fight]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
Gray Star eluded all [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassins]] until he was defeated by [[Cipher Nine]] of the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]].

==Biography==
The Gran who would become Gray Star was found by the [[Eagle]] some time after the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] left Balmorra per the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]'s terms. By [[3643 BBY]], Gray Star was undercover in a Republic base, leaving trusted allies such as [[Zenith]] in charge of the Resistance. He was eventually confronted by Cipher Nine and killed.

==Behind the scenes==
Gray Star's fate is decided by the player's choices: the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark Side]] choice is kill Gray Star on the spot, the neutral option is for Gray Star to be captured and impersonated by [[Sanju Pyne]] (only possible if Sanju survived the previous mission), the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Light side]] choice is to convince Gray Star to surrender in exchange for amnesty for his fighters.
